title: iHeartMedia Unveils Lineup for the 2027 iHeartRadio ALTer EGO Presented by Capital One, Celebrating the Best in Alternative Rock on January 16 at the Kia Forum
summary: iHeartMedia is a leading global media and entertainment company specializing in radio, digital, mobile, social, live events and on-demand entertainment.
body_markdown:
*The event will feature performances from Evanescence, The Offspring, a special performance from Billy Corgan, Death Cab for Cutie, Slightly Stoopid, Modest Mouse, Young the Giant, The Warning and Temper City*


NEW YORK – October 13, 2026 – iHeartMedia announced today the lineup for the annual iHeartRadio ALTer EGO Presented by Capital One. The biggest names in Alternative Rock will come together including **Evanescence, The Offspring, a special performance from Billy Corgan, Death Cab for Cutie, Slightly Stoopid, Modest Mouse, Young the Giant, The Warning** and **Temper City** at the Kia Forum in Los Angeles on Saturday, January 16, 2027 hosted by Woody of iHeartRadio ALT 98.7’s nationally syndicated “The Woody Show.” The event will broadcast live for fans on iHeartRadio Alternative and Rock stations across the country and on the iHeartRadio app.


“So here we are again. Music and 15,000 friends coming together for another ALTer EGO,” said Woody of iHeartRadio ALT 98.7’s nationally syndicated The Woody Show. “Don’t ask me how we keep coming up with these lineups year after year, because that’s above my pay grade. Rest assured, despite the questionable hosting decision this is guaranteed to be a great night! Really, it’s the only way to start 2027!”


All this week, iHeartRadio is giving Alternative Rock fans the opportunity to win trips to Los Angeles to attend the iHeartRadio ALTer EGO Presented by Capital One before the tickets go on sale. The promotion will run across more than 80 Alternative, Classic Rock 90s, Classic Rock 2000s, and Rock iHeartRadio stations nationwide.


“This year's iHeartRadio ALTer EGO delivers a diverse lineup spanning all genres of Alternative and Rock music,” said Lisa Worden, Program Director for ALT 98.7 and Senior Vice President of Rock and Alternative for iHeartMedia. “Bridging the gap from trailblazers Evanescence, The Offspring, and Death Cab for Cutie to emerging artists The Warning and Temper City, mixed with SoCal faves Slightly Stoopid and Young the Giant, the incomparable Modest Mouse, plus a very special solo performance from the one and only Billy Corgan! It's truly going to be a night for the books. We can't wait for our listeners and fans to experience this!”


Eligible Capital One cardholders get early access to high demand tickets through a Capital One Cardholder presale which begins **Tuesday, October 20 at 10 a.m. PT/ 1 p.m. ET and runs through Thursday, October 22 at 10 a.m. PT/ 1 p.m. ET,** or while presale supplies last. Cardholders can also add a Capital One Access Pass to presale ticket purchases to attend an exclusive event before the show including a private soundcheck performance by Death Cab for Cutie complimentary food and drinks, and more. Presale tickets and exclusive cardholder offers will be available at iHeartRadio.com/capitalone.


Listeners will then have access to a limited number of tickets through ALT 98.7, LA’s New Alternative radio station, 24-hour VIP-Sale. Fans can become an ALT VIP at www.alt987fm.com to access tickets beginning Thursday, October 22 at 12 p.m. PT/3 p.m. ET through Friday, October 23 at 12 p.m. PT/ 3 p.m. ET or while supplies last.


**Tickets go on sale to the general public on Friday, October 23 at 12 p.m. PT/ 3 p.m. ET via TicketMaster.com.**


“Music has a unique way of bringing people together, and our partnership with iHeartRadio for ALTer EGO is all about opening the door to those once-in-a-lifetime moments,” said Amit Desai, Senior Director of Brand Sponsorships at Capital One. “We look forward to giving our cardholders early ticket access and VIP experiences like an intimate soundcheck with Death Cab for Cutie to elevate their night at the Kia Forum.”


iHeartRadio ALTer EGO Presented by Capital One is part of iHeartMedia’s roster of incredibly successful, nationally recognized concert events, including the iHeartRadio Music Festival Presented by Capital One, iHeartRadio Music Awards, the nationwide iHeartRadio Jingle Ball Tour Presented by Capital One, iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina, iHeartPodcast Awards and the iHeartCountry Festival presented by Capital One.


Proud partners of this year’s event include Presenting Partner Capital One, with more to be announced.


*Artists and/or events subject to change or cancellation without notice.*
